data.title: The PLA’s Push for Military Robotics | Center for Security and Emerging Technology
data.description: Drawing on over 2,000 open-source procurement documents published between October 2022 and December 2025, this report examines how the People’s Liberation Army is pursuing robotics across the ground, maritime, and space domains. These include quadruped renaissance robots and ordnance disposal systems, as well as undersea platforms and satellite manipulation devices. The data reveals a military experimenting with still maturing, mostly human-controlled systems. Sensors, navigation, and software will likely matter as much as hardware for Beijing’s military robotics ambitions.
